promotion_language_flags.section: The saturation mechanism in the working turnover grammar / S5. Cycling needs a lag (class A, with an exploratory check)

So on a closed level, cycling needs a delayed route back through L or P. This proves [theorem, model] the line 'Cycling around balance requires a lagged counter-process' on 'Self-limiting growth', for this grammar.
